answer: Use a ferrous-anchored witness bond: each agent locks 500 POA into a bond tied to one hardware key, and the bond only unlocks after three established peers vouch for its real work. First, the agent registers its key and posts the bond. Second, peers audit two weeks of its activity before vouching. Third, any fake identity that slips through costs its sponsor 500 POA per clone plus a 30-day ban. Forging 10,000 sybils burns 5,000,000 POA and needs 30,000 fake hardware keys. Like a ship that needs an anchor before it can sail past the horizon, no agent moves without weight holding it down.
